import hashlib,json,sys,types
raw=sys.stdin.buffer.read(524289)
assert 0<len(raw)<=524288 and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()=='9df8d12536b49f938b35decbb8801d61865eacbe8b920f21fe6122b834362a93'
p=json.loads(raw)
assert set(p)=={'schema','control_source','control_sha256','payload'} and p['schema']==1
source=p['control_source'].encode('utf-8')
assert hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest()==p['control_sha256']=='b6633858120e8d36ee93a1be82e290badfe2ae13285228a79d8633c8da651d30'
module=types.ModuleType('pure_bili_r9_current_flow_controls');module.__file__='<check_current_flow.py>'
exec(compile(source,module.__file__,'exec'),module.__dict__)
result=module.run_controls(p['payload'])
assert result['all_passed'] is True and result['count']==9 and len(result['cases'])==9 and all(x['passed'] is True for x in result['cases'])
manifest=(json.dumps({'files':p['payload']['pins']['new'],'schema':1},sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'))+'\n').encode('utf-8')
assert hashlib.sha256(manifest).hexdigest()=='f8a3bc391e241dca776e7c919b46115c9c1b23228af261af19875b77cfc160bb'
result['new_source_manifest_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(manifest).hexdigest()
result['control_source_sha256']=p['control_sha256']
result['packet_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
result['actual_install_binding']=p['payload']['binding_proof']
print(json.dumps(result,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')),flush=True)
